$description: Tilde contact link (X1) test vectors, version 1, with the card face fields h and c (contact page v2) and email labels (contact v3). Spec: tilde-review/specs/x1-contact-link.md. encode: contact card fields (emailLabels beside emails) -> exact link (the app). decode: link -> contact or error (the page). vcard: link, the page's locale and the options it passes -> .vcf text (the page's Save contact). sticker: fields and a sticker's room in bytes -> the link that fits and what was left out, or null (the app). Keep every copy byte-identical.
